title: Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment [Switch 2]
description: Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment is a large-scale action game set in the ancient era connected to The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom. It combines Hyrule Warriors-style battles against large enemy forces with character-specific abilities and cooperative play features on Nintendo Switch 2. The game is a native Nintendo Switch 2 release.

description_short: A Nintendo Switch 2 Hyrule Warriors action game depicting the ancient Imprisoning War with large-scale battles and two-player options.
description_ar: Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment هي لعبة أكشن واسعة النطاق تدور في الحقبة القديمة المرتبطة بأحداث The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom. تجمع بين معارك Hyrule Warriors ضد أعداد كبيرة من الأعداء وقدرات خاصة بكل شخصية وخيارات للعب التعاوني على Nintendo Switch 2، وهي إصدار أصلي للجهاز.

worldSummary: The story explores ancient Hyrule during the Imprisoning War, before the modern-era events depicted in Tears of the Kingdom.

storyChapters.title: The Imprisoning War
storyChapters.body: The story explores the ancient conflict surrounding Rauru, Sonia, Zelda, and Ganondorf during the era referenced in The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom.

storyChapters.title: Hyrule at War
storyChapters.body: Players command multiple heroes across large battlefields, defending settlements and completing objectives while the Demon King expands his forces.

storyChapters.title: The Battle for the Kingdom
storyChapters.body: The campaign builds toward the decisive struggle that establishes the history later remembered as the Imprisoning War.
